captions.attica: Attica, and the city of Athena.
captions.acropolis: The Acropolis, with Athens at its feet.

glauka: Hoo! I'm Glauka, Athena's own owl.
Athens is full of stories: true ones, myths, old tales and a few tourist fibs.
Find the flags, hear the stories, and earn owl coins. I'll help you find your way.

tutorial.text: First, move! Drag anywhere on the screen (or use the arrow keys). On streets you roll on your skateboard, twice as fast.
See the flags? Walk up to one and press A, the round button, to hear its story.
And the compass up there: its gold needle points to the next big story. Follow it, and I'll follow you. Hoo!

idleHint: Hoo! Stuck? The gold needle on the compass points to {title}.
